So one possible disconnection yields two fragments: fragment A: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1 (looks like target but with nH instead of nnn? Actually original had c2nnn(Cc3... )c2N; after disconnection maybe removed the Cc3... substituent). Fragment B: FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1 (some fluorinated piperidine with a chlorophenyl). That seems plausible.

We need to continue with template 1914394 applied to one of the fragments (likely the first fragment). Let's check applicability of 1914394 to fragment A.
